lce.title: Memory — Local Cognitive Extension (LCE)
lce.noSources: No documents yet. Put your files in the sources folder (or add folders later); they stay local and immutable.
lce.c0note: C0 means Swarmbly unchanged: the protocol runs exactly as specified, with no memory components.
lce.c1note: C1 prepares your local source space with a conservative policy: nothing trains without your explicit permission (invariant I8).
lce.workers: Workers always serve the base model. Your personal memory never travels to another device (invariant I2).

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataDirHint: Documents, wiki, outputs, database and identity live here — never in the repository.
settings.recoHint: The app never downloads models. Install one with your package manager, e.g.:

help.language: UI language. Applies immediately; stored in your data directory.
help.theme: Visual theme. Dark is the default; light reduces eye strain in bright rooms.
help.reduceMotion: Disables animations (typing cursor, blinks) for motion sensitivity.
help.backend: Where inference runs. Auto tries Ollama first, then an OpenAI-compatible server.
help.backendUrl: For Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434. For llama.cpp/vLLM/OpenAI: the /v1 endpoint.
help.apiKey: Only needed for OpenAI-compatible servers that require a key. Stored locally.
help.modelName: The local model used for chat and as orchestrator. Empty = auto-pick first detected.
help.maxTokens: Maximum output tokens per local answer.
help.temperature: Sampling temperature. Lower = more deterministic, higher = more varied.
help.mode: Local never leaves the device. LAN can dispatch to workers on your network. Auto falls back to local when privacy or the router require it.
help.lan: Announce and discover Swarmbly nodes on your local network via mDNS (no manual IPs).
help.worker: Voluntarily serve micro-tasks to other nodes. Nothing is served until this is on.
help.workerIdle: Serve only when the machine is idle (low CPU).
help.workerConcurrent: How many tasks this node serves at once. Lower = less resource use.
help.redundancy: k = replicas per micro-task (min–max). k>1 enables cross-model consensus; agreement is never reported as truth.
help.rho: Context budget multiplier sent with each fragment. Higher = more context (and more privacy exposure).
help.tier: LOCAL: nothing leaves the device. GLOBAL: any conformant worker. TRUSTED: whitelist + mutual TLS (Phase 2.1).
help.lceEnabled: Turn the Local Cognitive Extension on/off. Disabled (C0) keeps Swarmbly exactly as specified.
help.lceLevel: C0 = Swarmbly unchanged. C1 = local sources with a policy where nothing trains by default.
help.learning: Always OFF in v0.1. Nothing enters model weights without explicit permission (invariant I8).
help.reportDetail: How much processing detail goes into reports (JSON/Markdown/HTML).
help.profile: Preset grouping of the options above. Automatic prioritizes safety and stability.

wizard.title: Welcome to Swarmbly
wizard.intro: A few checks to set up your node correctly.
wizard.systemHint: What Swarmbly can see of your hardware. Unknown values are reported as unknown — never invented.
wizard.modelsHint: Swarmbly speaks to Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server. The app never downloads models on its own.
wizard.privacyHint: By default everything stays LOCAL: no request leaves this device. You can opt into swarm modes later, explicitly.
wizard.lceHint: Optional. Level C0 keeps Swarmbly unchanged. You can prepare C1 (local sources) later.
